bullets: SERVICE DRIVE ENTRY: Reads SERVICE DRIVE / PULL FORWARD / AND WAIT FOR ADVISOR. Specific wording for the dealership service drive, written for auto dealerships, car rental and used car lots.
WHY IT MATTERS: Spells out "SERVICE DRIVE PULL FORWARD AND WAIT FOR ADVISOR" in bold letters people can read from across the room, so the message is clear without anyone having to ask.

WHERE TO POST IT: At eye level on the wall, door or post where people in the service drive area will see it first. Mounts with screws, rivets or zip ties through the pre-drilled corner holes. Ordered by dealership general managers and service directors.
BUILT FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: Heavy-duty .065 aluminum with a rust-resistant, UV-resistant printed finish, backed by a five-year warranty against fading, peeling and rust.

READY TO MOUNT, MADE IN USA: 8x12 inch landscape sign with four pre-drilled corner holes for screws, rivets or bolts. Bold white lettering on a black field with a white keyline border, readable from a parked car. Made by CGAP Safety.
